source.text:
This is you Berlin food guide so be ready eat GOOD 🫦

I love you Berlin 🫶🏻

1. Wurst Pate
2. Zacharias Tagesbar
3. Niko Izakaya
4. Bar Pluto 
5. Ikigai Teabar
6. Gaffel Haus, Brauhaus Restaurant 
7. Atelier Dough
8. Annelies
9. Lap Coffee
10. Canal
11. Sofi
12. Shodo Udon Lab
13. Gate Kebab

#berlin #berlinfood #berlinfoodspots #berlinbrunch #whattodoinberlin
source.subtitles:
Berlin has to be one of the best foodie cities,
so you better bet that I freaking ate my way through it.
13 spots. Get ready and listen up!
Started at worst paid for a curry west
of course. Run by the most lovely lady.
€5. 60 for a mound of fries
party sausages with that delicious curry sauce.
I mean cargo. Next up is the cutest one.
I'm bar with so many outdoor seating.
Generally the most perfect way to spend your afternoon
hopping over to Japan real quick.
Nikko Zakai literally feels like you're in Tokyo.
Small dishes, very reasonably price.
We pretty much ordered the whole menu.
It was all so delicious.
But make sure you get the grilled miso pork and the beef cutlet.
Oh my favourite bar that we went to was Bar Pluto.
The vibes, the dim lighting,
everything was just sexy. Okay,
if you're craving matcha,
Ikigai Teabar has such fun drinks like this mango sticky rice matcha.
Our house restaurant has all the German food that you want.
Pork knuckle schnitzels, braised beef.
Perfect spot to just take that.
German food get off the list,
you know? Oh my gosh,
if you like doughnuts, this maple bacon from Natalia Dough
was genuinely the best doughnut I've ever had in my life.
So many options to choose from,
and freshly made every day as well.
I'm sure you've heard of Annalise,
probably the most famous brunch spot in Berlin.
And I genuinely mean This,
but it's not overhyped at all.
Just do yourself a favour and get that breakfast sandwich.
Oh okay. Lap coffee of stores all around Germany.
Great spot to just grab a quick coffee or a matcha.
Love the aesthetics as well.
Canal in Berlin is known for the gelato.
Do not miss out on their pastries,
especially this tiramisu.
They've got all your classic pastries and even this apricot croissant.
Divine. If you love your baked goods,
Sophie definitely has everything that you're looking for. Cookies,
croissants for katsu sandwiches.
And if you try the soft serve,
please let me know if it's good.
Hands down the best udon I've ever had.
Freshly made in house, right in front of you.
Shodo Udon Lab knows what's up.
Perfectly thick and chewy in that super yummy broth.
And you can't leave Berlin without having a kebab.
Can you literally believe that this was a smaller sized Donna?
Honestly, save this post,
send it to a friend, and do whatever you gotta do. Happy eating!

reference.notes: Venues are attributed by matching the transcript's garbled names (worst paid, Nikko Zakai, Our house, Natalia Dough, Annalise, Sophie, Donna) to the caption list in order. The kebab line is read as a city-level remark, and the rhetorical 'smaller sized' döner as praise of the portion rather than a question.

match.note: 'Zacharias' is a distinctive name and the café fits the description, though the listing says Kaffeebar rather than Tagesbar.
'Bar Pluto' is taken to be the Pluto wine bar, the only Pluto candidate.
